question: What kind of knowable reality is realized when the body is transcended?
premises: There is a moment of transcending the body.
At that moment something becomes knowable.
That knowable is non-body and devoid of body.
inference: Transcending the body reveals a knowable reality that is entirely non-bodily.
plain_english: When the knowable that transcends the body is realized, it is non-body and devoid of body.
